entry_state: The opening has established why identical journals can conceal different future exposures: fixed and floating debt share historical interest of 5 but generate next-year interest of 5 and 7. A mixture produces a feasible interval, with no probability measure supplied by enumeration or confidence. The intended system must retain the economic causes of accounting results, distinguish evidence from assumptions, and expose unsupported scope. Its first demonstration must join three dates, a revision and complete statement effects without implying forecast accuracy. Chapter 2 now owes the reader that company-level demonstration and a real-disclosure contrast.
exit_state: Northstar now supplies opening and half-year movements, exact annual working-capital bridges, three-date statements, public-versus-system revision queries and a conditional 2025 forecast with one shared debt parameter. The portable chain retains quantities, atomic delivery, missing outputs and exact-retry identity; a changed-rate control guards against shared frontend errors. The January projection is explicitly archival because the corrected opening became public in March. The next section has introduced a separate parent/subsidiary company with supplied opening balances and narrow tax premises, and must show how one close combines return, debt, tax and ownership effects.

findings.judgment: Opening balances, movement units and half-year accrual timing precede the reconstruction bridges. C=245, P=155 and S=145 follow the specified no-write-off/no-acquisition/no-FX model; they do not identify invoices or the fixed/floating split. The table and continuation explain delivery, purchases and prepaid tax before the statements use them.

The 190/197/220.6 balance-sheet totals, profit 29.6 and direct/indirect operating cash 45.6 use the same movements. Revenue correction 120 to 110 retains the old report, distinguishes March availability from ingestion and forbids incompatible annual-minus-interim vintages.

The 2025 assumptions produce one joint cash/profit/equity family, not separately chosen extrema. The floating-share change of variables is explicit. Equation 2.4 changes slope with the imposed rate, and the surrounding text identifies the projection as archival rather than an investor forecast at the January origin. Partial collection/tax information remains unresolved rather than zero.

Receipt lookup and exact retry are distinguished from changed-request conflicts and stale new work. The following company composition begins with declared parent/subsidiary balances, 80-percent ownership, narrow supplied tax law and historical standard anchors. Its joining calculations have not yet been read. No new confirmed defect or clipped material was observed.

equation.symbols_units_domain: C, P and S are annual currency amounts for collections, inventory purchases and supplier payments. The constants are opening/closing balances, annual sales 260 and annual cost of sales 165.
equation.assumptions_timing: The same company, currency and annual period apply to every term. Northstar excludes write-offs, acquisitions and FX; purchases and sales have the credit/cost meanings given immediately before the section.
equation.source_and_equality: Correct local exact balance identities. Rearrangement gives C=20+260-35=245, P=20-30+165=155 and S=20+155-30=145. No external theorem or observed real-company reconstruction is claimed.
equation.interpretation: Collections reduce receivables; purchases increase both inventory and payables; delivery reduces inventory at cost; settlement reduces payables. Adding omitted economic movements would change the bridges and possibly uniqueness.
equation.transition: The debt contrast shows why identifying some totals does not identify all economic causes. The recovered amounts then feed the complete statements; no new runtime execution follows from this author algebra check.

equation.symbols_units_domain: I is annual currency interest, x in [0,1] is floating principal share, r is the imposed annual floating rate, and total principal is 100.
equation.assumptions_timing: Both loan parts stay outstanding over the full forecast year; the fixed part pays 5 percent and the floating part immediately takes r. The supplied 20-percent tax rule applies to the described positive-profit comparisons.
equation.source_and_equality: Correct exact local decomposition: fixed interest is 5(1-x), floating interest is 100rx, and their sum is 5+(100r-5)x. It is a synthetic conditional calculation rather than a market estimate.
equation.interpretation: At r=0.07 the floating-share slope is 2; at r=0.09 it is 4. More floating exposure lowers profit and cash by 0.8 times those interest increases under the supplied tax timing.
equation.transition: The changed slope is a control against shared constant errors in both authoring frontends. The next paragraphs preserve exact joint dependence and distinguish archival opening information from what an investor knew in January.
